'''1997 Ord Mantell Regionals (Tokyo)''' was the Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] in the Ord Mantell region (Japan).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Ord Mantell)
* '''Date:''' 2 November 1997
* '''Site:''' Techno-Plaza Katsushika, Tokyo, Japan
